contents.text: {"hypotheses":[{"experiment_id":"carry","text":"If Holt had carried the ball forward instead of passing, his chance to score would have been higher than what happened (carry > 7.3%)."},{"experiment_id":"shoot","text":"If Holt had shot instead of passing, his chance to score would have been much lower than what happened (shoot < 7.3%)."},{"experiment_id":"tight_H9","text":"If defender Mateo Brann had been 5 m closer to Holt, the scoring chance from Holt’s decision would have decreased (tight_H9 < 7.3%)."}]}
